messages:
maria: Quick copy nit from the audit — the confirmation modal for archiving a model version uses a primary button label `Move to archive…` (with an ellipsis). Feels odd for a final action. Also spotted that some translations render the ellipsis oddly and it can wrap onto a new line.

sam: +1. Primary CTA should be definitive. Ellipsis communicates 'more coming' which is misleading here.

alex: From an implementation POV the button currently has a `title` attr with the same string (including the ellipsis) and the aria-label is `Archive version, show more`. I'll remove the ellipsis and tighten the aria label.

olivia: Localization note: some locales (eg. JA, ZH) don't conventionally use the 3-dot ellipsis and translators often substitute a different glyph or spacing, which breaks visual alignment. Avoiding the ellipsis makes i18n cleaner and reduces QA churn.

maria: Proposed copy options to choose between:
- Option A (concise): Primary: `Archive version`  Secondary: `Cancel`
- Option B (explicit): Primary: `Archive version and snapshots`  Secondary: `Cancel`
- For the small helper line we can use: `This will remove the version from the active list. You can restore it from Archive.`

sam: I prefer Option A for clarity and to keep the modal short. Also let's ensure the primary button contrast meets AA for the chosen color.

alex: I'll send a tiny PR: remove ellipsis in markup, update i18n key `modal.archive.primary_cta` to `Archive version`, and double-check aria-label becomes `Archive version` (no trailing punctuation).

l10n-bot: Heads up: i18n keys impacted — modal.archive.title, modal.archive.primary_cta, modal.archive.helper_text. Marking for translation: en->all locales.

maria: Thanks — I'll update Figma components and add a short note in the modal docs about avoiding ellipses in CTAs and accessible aria labels. Will post the updated mock in #design when done. :thumbsup:
